items.name: Thrusting Flurry
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The waveriders launch coordinated attacks against each enemy in a 5-foot emanation with a DC 27 basic Reflex save save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8+6 piercing damage

2 3d8+6 piercing damage

3 4d8+9 piercing damage

items.name: Wavecrash
items.text: The waveriders conjure a cresting wave beneath their feet and use it ride down their enemies. The waveriders Stride up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures or troops composed of Medium or smaller creatures. Creatures in the path of the waveriders take 1d8+6 bludgeoning damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save save).
